name: Niizuma Onna Kyoushi
source:
Main character has to marry a childhood friend due to an old promise. But he is a student, and she is a teacher in his class, so their relations must be kept in secret. Female teacher starts to bully protagonist at school and fiercely oppress at home in bed. What will become of their married life?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-january-2008-fortune.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角因旧约而不得不与青梅竹马结婚。但他是学生，她是班里的老师，他们的关系必须保密。女老师开始在学校欺负主角，在家床上狠狠欺压。他们的婚姻生活将会怎样？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-january-2008-fortune.html]vndbreview[/url]]
